issues.issue: Did the Officer misunderstand or fail to properly take into account the psychological report when assessing the testimony?
issues.applicant_position: Officer misunderstood the psychological report and failed to consider it when assessing testimony (paras 21, 24).
issues.respondent_position: Relied on Garay Moscol: omission to comment on a psychological report is not an error absent a connection (para 29).
issues.result_quote: In the result, I am satisfied that the Applicant simply cannot succeed on this ground

issues.issue: Was the general non-credibility finding reasonably open to the Officer on the evidence?
issues.applicant_position: Credibility and plausibility findings were made without regard to the evidence or on no evidence; the decision is unreasonable (para 21).
issues.result_quote: I find no basis to conclude that the Officer ignored or failed to adequately take into account any element of the totality of the evidence
